title: Identification of antioxidant peptides targeting Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway from in vitro digestion of pork sausage with partial substitution of NaCl by KCl.
authors: Zou, Lifang; Yu, Xia; Cai, Kezhou; Xu, Baocai; Chen, Conggui; Xiao, Guiran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究猪肉香肠消化产物中抗氧化肽激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路，核心是蛋白-小肽与信号通路调控，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1)-nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)-antioxidant response elements (ARE) pathway is one of the most important cellular defense mechanisms against oxidative stress. This study focuses on finding antioxidant peptides from in vitro digestion products of pork sausage with partial substitution of NaCl by KCl by virtual screening. Six antioxidant peptides, LIVGFPAYGH, DWWGSTVR, WNSLLIR, IVGFPAYGH, FDNLWDQGL, and LRSPSWDPF, could activate the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway and protect cells from oxidative stress. DWWGSTVR exhibits the most robust activity among them. Further studies indicated that DWWGSTVR could increase the expression of many antioxidant enzymes by enabling the transfer of Nrf2 from the cytoplasm to the nucleus. In summary, these six peptides are proven to be Nrf2 activators and could be used as functional foods to prevent and treat various oxidative stress-induced diseases.
abstract_zh: Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）-核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）-抗氧化反应元件（ARE）通路是细胞对抗氧化应激最重要的防御机制之一。本研究旨在通过虚拟筛选，从部分以KCl替代NaCl的猪肉香肠体外消化产物中寻找抗氧化肽。六种抗氧化肽，LIVGFPAYGH、DWWGSTVR、WNSLLIR、IVGFPAYGH、FDNLWDQGL和LRSPSWDPF，能够激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路并保护细胞免受氧化应激损伤。其中，DWWGSTVR表现出最强的活性。进一步研究表明，DWWGSTVR可通过促进Nrf2从细胞质向细胞核转移，增加多种抗氧化酶的表达。总之，这六种肽被证实为Nrf2激活剂，可作为功能性食品用于预防和治疗多种氧化应激诱导的疾病。
